Converter / waveform & three-level NPC, quarter-wave symmetric, alternating level steps \\
Switching angles $N$ & 15 per quarter cycle \\
Objective & THD$_{49}$ over odd non-triplen orders 5, 7, \ldots, 49 (16 orders) \\
Imbalance terms & even non-triplen orders $2,4,8,\ldots,46$, exactly linear in $\delta$ \\

Minimum pulse width & $\theta_{k+1}-\theta_k \ge \theta_{gap}$, $\theta_{gap} = 0.25^\circ$ (1-D, 2-D) \\
Solver & MATLAB \texttt{fmincon}, SQP, analytic gradients of objective and constraint \\
Tolerances & optimality and constraint $10^{-10}$, step $10^{-12}$, 600 iterations \\
Multistart & 150 uniformly random feasible starts at each of 11 anchors; 100 at each of 50 probe points (step 0.01) \\
Continuation & secant predictor, $\Delta M_a = 0.0025$, jump limit 0.50$^\circ$ \\
Operating range, $M_a$ & 0.70--1.20 \\
Operating range, $\delta$ & 0.000--0.130 ($r = 1.00$--$1.30$) \\
